messages:
sara (AE): Quick heads-up — Vectorix wants a 7-day POC. They have a custom filtered-llama-13b variant and need private VPC + KMS + EU data residency. Need compatibility + rough pricing.
diego (Sales-Eng): Call notes: target p95 < 220ms, typical seq len 128, bursty traffic ~500 qps. They prefer q8_0 but can do q4_0 if quality drops.
mei (ML Eng): Checklist: tokenizer type, position embeddings (RoPE/ALiBi), any custom CUDA ops, and sample prompts. For 13B q8_0 we can do shardless single A100. Ask for model.tar with pytorch.bin + tokenizer + config + checksums.
gita (Security): Got their sec packet. Require CMK, audit logs 180d, SOC2. Need deletion workflow and SCIM. If VPC deploy, keys stay in customer KMS. I'll mark any high-risk items.
diego (Sales-Eng): Propose two POC paths: (A) customer-VPC private deploy (fastest, keys retained by customer), (B) Redwood-hosted private tenancy in eu-west with CMK. Include hosted fallback option for spikes.
sara (AE): Action items: Mei to validate artifact layout; Gita to redline security; Diego to draft POC quote and node sizing. I'll send checklist to customer.
deply-bot: provision-request accepted: vectorix-poc-eu scheduled on 1xA100-80GB, 20GB logs.
mei (ML Eng): Upload layout suggestion: model.tar.gz (pytorch_model.bin, tokenizer.json, config.json), sample_prompts.jsonl (50), checksums.sha256. Presigned S3 preferred. I'll run a dry compatibility test once uploaded.
sara (AE): Thanks — I'll send this to Vectorix and target a kickoff next week.
__notes: Short Slack thread, follows agents.md structure.
